scope: HarnessMesh session UX on one computer, real Pi through pi-acp; approval path with Pi is not available (Pi never asks over ACP)

environment.model: a DeepSeek Flash model served by a local gateway

tested.detail: both sidebar rows showed 进行中 within the same screen; both turns completed
content rendered in 32-38 ms; no message crossed between sessions

tested.check: draft while a turn is running
tested.detail: the draft stays in the composer; Ctrl+Enter was silently ignored (now shows a short notice)

tested.before: session stayed 进行中 indefinitely; cancel did not finish it; only 关闭会话 recovered
tested.after: after cancel, 10 s grace then the agent process is ended; session idle with 中断 error, tool card failed, a follow-up message continued normally in 2 s

tested.detail: session came back idle with last_error; the raw English message is now translated in the panel (Agent 进程已退出，这一轮中断)

tested.check: daemon unavailable while the panel is open
tested.before: a single banner repeated PEER_UNREACHABLE for eight sections and the summary said 只读模式 · 现有 Daemon 保持运行
tested.after: one sentence: 本机 Daemon 没有响应…；summary says 只读模式 · Daemon 不可达

fixes: cancel escalates after 10 s: the agent process is ended and the turn is marked interrupted
an agent death closes unfinished tool cards with a failed state
panel maps agent-exit errors and the stop-timeout note to Chinese
daemon-down banner is one sentence instead of raw codes
Ctrl+Enter while a turn runs shows a notice instead of doing nothing
remaining: without a cancel click, a dead agent still leaves the session 进行中 until the owner acts
messages typed while a turn runs are not queued; only drafts are kept
approval UX (允许一次/拒绝/等待授权) is not exercised by Pi and still needs Claude Code or Codex
